verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-retention settings, retention periods, or account- or tenant-level data deletion or purge controls for data Vanta holds. The closest items are a single 'Delete a contract by ID' API endpoint and GDPR 'privacy workflows'. The endpoint is ordinary record management, an adjacent feature rather than a retention control. The GDPR workflows help customers run their own compliance programs and say nothing about controlling Vanta's own retention.
